criteria.c: correct explicit device extractions (exata+provavel) / expected explicit device refs >= 0.95

matching: Exact norm number, year and article; whole-norm fallback does not recall a device. Private-device proposals count as erroneous if exata. One-to-one matching. No post-run relabeling.
synthetic: Two captures per norm: union of all expected and proposed articles; separate alien article 99999 only. Definitive full-norm results are permitted for genuine whole-norm expectations. Any definitive wrong interpretation is false.
